question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the Peninsular Plateau?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Northern Plain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Peninsular Plateau:

 
 
• India's peninsular plateau lies to the south of the Northern Plains of India.
 
• The whole peninsular plateau region is made of several smaller plateaus and hill ranges distributed with river basins and valleys. 
 
• The average height of elevation of the Peninsular plateau is 600-900 m.
 
• The general elevation of the plateau is from the west to the east.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Deccan Plateau

 
 
• The Deccan Plateau in southern India is located between the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats.
 
• It is the peninsular region between these ranges that is south of the Narmada river.
 
• To the north, it is bounded by the Satpura and Vindhya Ranges.
 
 
 
• **The Central Highland​**
 
 
• The part of the Peninsular plateau lying to the north of the Narmada river, covering a major area of the Malwa plateau, is known as the Central Highlands.
 
• The Vindhyan range is bounded by the Satpura range on the south and the Aravalis on the northwest.
 
 

 
• The Northeastern Plateau

 
 
• It consists of The Vindhyan Ranges, and Satpura ranges.
